messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D survival sandbox game with a rooftop skyscraper, island-house sandbox, and endless-zombie arena.
- Include non-blocky NPCs, touch controls, weapons, health, spawning, and combat.

## Requirements
- Hold the spawn button to open a roster with neutral-until-hit police officers (pistol or shotgun), hostile knife-wielding bandits, and zombies whose limbs can explode off.
- Add a weapon hotbar, attack/fire/reload buttons, health bar, joystick movement, and right-side look controls.
- Rooftop starting map: NPCs explode when they fall off.
- Island sandbox map: house must have colliders.
- Arena map: disable NPC spawning and survive infinite zombie waves.

## Decisions
- Implemented the project as a standalone Three.js browser game in `index.html`.
- Used stylized, rounded humanoid NPCs and procedural environment geometry; gore is represented by stylized blood effects and detachable zombie limbs.
- Spawn roster currently toggles by clicking rather than requiring a hold gesture.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the Three.js game, responsive HUD, three maps, NPC types, combat and damage, touch/keyboard controls, weapon hotbar, and arena waves in `index.html`.
- Added island house collision handling and rooftop edge fall damage/NPC fall behavior.
- Syntax-checked the module successfully with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and captured/inspected `screenshots/last-light.jpg`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Browser check reported only a missing `favicon.ico` (404); no game runtime errors were reported.

## Next Move
1. Consider changing the spawn roster interaction to genuinely open on hold, per the user's explicit requirement.
2. Test map switching, gameplay, NPC damage, arena wave progression, and mobile controls in-browser.
3. Address the harmless missing favicon if desired.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire playable game implementation and UI.
- `screenshots/last-light.jpg`: latest captured game screenshot.

## Important Context
- Local browser server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright successfully loaded the page; console showed a favicon 404 and WebGL performance warnings only.
- Changes are uncommitted.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D survival sandbox game with rooftop, island-house, and endless-zombie arena maps.
- Update the existing game to open its NPC roster when the spawn button is held.

## Requirements
- Hold the spawn button to open a roster with neutral-until-hit police officers (pistol or shotgun), hostile knife-wielding bandits, and zombies with detachable limbs.
- Include weapon hotbar, attack/fire/reload buttons, health bar, joystick movement, and right-side look controls.
- Rooftop NPCs should explode when they fall off; the island house needs colliders; arena disables spawning and has infinite zombie waves.
- Use non-blocky people.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone Three.js browser game in `index.html`, with stylized rounded humanoids and procedural environments.
- Gore is stylized with blood effects and detachable zombie limbs.
- Spawn roster supports a click toggle as well as a hold gesture (360 ms).

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the three maps, HUD, NPCs, combat, weapons, touch/keyboard controls, arena waves, island house collision handling, and rooftop fall behavior in `index.html`.
- Added per-weapon ammo persistence across hotbar switches.
- Added hold-to-open spawn roster behavior.
- JavaScript module syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs`.
- Game loaded in Playwright earlier; no runtime errors were reported then.

### Active
- Verify map switching and gameplay after recent edits.

### Blocked
- Playwright click on the island map tab timed out because the game canvas intercepted pointer events (`canvas ... intercepts pointer events`).

## Next Move
1. Fix UI clickability, likely by ensuring the `.ui` overlay and its controls receive pointer events while the canvas does not block them.
2. Reload the page and test map switching, spawn hold behavior, combat, arena waves, and mobile controls.
3. Optionally add a favicon to clear the harmless `/favicon.ico` 404.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire playable game implementation.
- `screenshots/last-light.jpg`: latest captured game screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright console previously showed a missing favicon 404 and WebGL performance warnings; no reported game runtime errors.
